result.summary: The food delivery home screen renders mostly correctly, but one card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel displays a raw JavaScript 'NaN' value in its delivery fee text, indicating a data/formatting bug.

issues.description: The 'Smash Bros Burgers' card in the 'Fastest near you' section shows '€NaN delivery' instead of a valid price, exposing an unformatted numeric error to the user.
issues.suggestion: Guard the delivery fee formatting against undefined/null values, ensure the API returns a numeric fee, and fall back to a sensible label (e.g. 'Free delivery' or 'Delivery fee unavailable') when the value is missing.
